Political.title_translated: スペインの権力争い
Political.summary_translated: 2026年11月29日のスペイン総選挙は、住宅問題が主要な争点となっている。10月には議会がプリムが導入した緊急令について投票を行った。

Political.title_translated: 専門家の見解：中間選挙と世界における米国の地位
Political.summary_translated: スティムソン研究所の専門家は、民主党による下院と上院の支配を含む米国の中間選挙結果が、今後の外交政策をどのように形作るかを探求している。

Political.title_translated: Trump Diplomacy After the Midterms: The World Fears a Runaway
Political.summary_translated: The international community is alarmed that President Trump, who suffered a major defeat in the U.S. midterm elections, may become even more autocratic in nature. With a lame-duck status now certain for his remaining two-year term, there is a risk of diplomatic recklessness as he seeks to build his political legacy.

Political.title_translated: Jay Clayton Assumes Office as U.S. Director of National Intelligence Amid Democratic Opposition
Political.summary_translated: Jay Clayton has taken office as Director of National Intelligence, overseeing intelligence agencies including the CIA. Democratic lawmakers opposed his confirmation after he refused to clearly acknowledge that President Trump lost the 2020 presidential election during Senate confirmation hearings.

Political.title_translated: U.S. Midterm Elections in Three Months: Focus on Expanding Independent Voter Support
Political.summary_translated: With three months remaining until the U.S. midterm elections, which will also serve as a referendum on the Trump administration, both Republicans and Democrats are expected to compete closely for control of both chambers of Congress. The key focus is whether each party can expand its support among independent voters.

Political.title_translated: Presidential Election in Cabo Verde: Issues in One of Africa's Most Stable Democracies
Political.summary_translated: 大統領選挙は、政党の忠誠心と投票者の大統領職への期待、および政治体制における大統領の役割をめぐって試われることになる。

Political.title_translated: 災厄を待つのか？ ブレント・ボゼル氏と米国・南アフリカ関係
Political.summary_translated: ドナルド・トランプ大統領による2025年のレオ・ブレント・ボゼル氏の駐南アフリカ米国大使への任命は、意図的な挑発行為であった。

Political.title_translated: ロシアとの和解の時が来た
Political.summary_translated: 10月、米国のドナルド・トランプ大統領は、ロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン大統領から軽油を確保するための土壇場の取引を売却し、彼の制裁を一時停止した。

Political.title_translated: Argentina: Indigenous Communities Face New Wave of Evictions
Political.summary_translated: Argentine indigenous communities are facing a new wave of evictions from lands they consider ancestral territories, as of September 23, 2026.

Political.title_translated: 中国は状況を誤読しているのか
Political.summary_translated: 米国のドナルド・トランプ大統領が今週後半にアジア太平洋経済協力サミットのため深圳に到着する際、中国の指導者と会談することになる。

Political.title_translated: 安易な金融政策は選挙には勝たない
Political.summary_translated: 政治家は長年、安易な金融政策が選挙に勝つと信じて中央銀行に低金利を求めてきた。本コラムはその前提を検証している。

Political.title_translated: Argentine Delegation Seeks U.S. Support for Cristina Fernández de Kirchner's Legal Fight
Political.summary_translated: An Argentine delegation is lobbying in Washington for support regarding Cristina Fernández de Kirchner's legal case, with former Foreign Minister Jorge Taiana heading the campaign to challenge her convictions.

Political.title_translated: 国連がキューバ対米国禁輸令の廃止を毎年投票：一方的制裁と人権への影響について何を意味するのか
Political.summary_translated: 米国のキューバに対する禁輸令に関する国連の年次決議は、一方的制裁、国際法、国家主権の間の緊張の高まりを明かにしている。

Political.title_translated: Serbia's Authoritarian Regime Falls: Grassroots Movement Achieves Victory, But Can It Overcome the Difficult Path to a New Beginning?
Political.summary_translated: In Serbia's parliamentary election, the grassroots movement 'Student List' won by a landslide, ousting President Vučić from power after 12 years. While this is a historic victory and a political earthquake in Southeast Europe, the Student List still faces difficult challenges ahead.

Political.title_translated: ブラジルの振り子
Political.summary_translated: ブラジル政治の最近数年間は、極端な混乱と分極化によって特徴付けられている。国家政治が特定の方向に向かっていたほぼ20年間の後。

Political.title_translated: NATO Parliamentary Assembly Convenes Amid Russian Airspace Violations
Political.summary_translated: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and German Foreign Minister Wadephul are set to address the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin while NATO representatives monitor Russian airspace violations.

Political.title_translated: PT Denounces Actions of Janones' 'Army' in Government
Political.summary_translated: The country awaits President Luiz Inácio da Silva's (PT) decisions regarding the composition of his government in his fourth term, having already warned about certain conditions.

Political.title_translated: カンヌ市長ダヴィド・リスナルは仏大統領選挙の穴馬か
Political.summary_translated: フランス大統領候補ダヴィド・リスナルは最近の世論調査で元首相エドゥアール・フィリップとガブリエル・アタルを上回り、多くの人を驚かせている。

Political.title_translated: 政府指導者が自律型兵器に関する条約交渉の開始を11月から呼びかけ
Political.summary_translated: 6カ国、OHCHR、赤十字国際委員会、エルダーズ、FLIが共催したニューヨークフォーラムで、各国の大臣とUN関係者は、自律型兵器に関する条約交渉の開始を各国に呼びかけた。

Political.title_translated: Trump's 'Big Mistake': Disrespecting Allies and Giving China a Stage as the World Order Leader Through the Farce of the U.S.-China-Russia Trilateral Summit
Political.summary_translated: At the 2026 APEC leaders' meeting held in rapidly growing Shenzhen, the 'G3' summit among the U.S., China, and Russia, opaque WTO discussions, and the apparent 'cold treatment' of the Japanese Prime Minister have caused ripples. As the interests of major powers intersect, international order and Japan's role are at stake.

Economic.title_translated: [11/20 Online Event] From Regulatory Monitoring to Circular Business Calculations: What You Can Do with "Circular Tool Box" (Circular Economy Hub Renewal Anniversary Event)
Economic.summary_translated: To commemorate the renewal of Circular Economy Hub, a free online event will be held on November 20 showcasing the "Circular Tool Box," a suite of practical data tools for understanding regulatory trends and conducting financial feasibility studies for circular businesses. The event will demonstrate actual operation screens and provide insights from business support experts on key points for business planning and internal proposals.

Economic.title_translated: Economic Loss from Cyberattacks on Japanese Companies - Update: Damage Extends from Individual Companies to Social Infrastructure: UK Government Estimates Cyberattack Costs at 0.5% of GDP - Nomura Research Institute (NRI)
Economic.summary_translated: Economic losses from cyberattacks on Japanese companies have expanded from individual corporate damage to impacts on social infrastructure. According to UK government estimates, the economic cost of cyberattacks represents approximately 0.5% of GDP.

Economic.title_translated: [Stock Price Surges] Nvidia Announces Immediate Return of Jensen Huang as President and CEO | Politics, Economy & Investment | Toyo Keizai Online
Economic.summary_translated: Nvidia shocked the market by bringing back Jensen Huang as President and CEO, with stock prices surging over 31% temporarily. The dramatic leadership move had an immediate and significant impact on the company's valuation.

Economic.title_translated: Nikkei Average Falls Well Below 60,000 Yen, But Don't Despair Yet: What Are the Conditions for Stock Price 'Bottom-In Signals' to Light Up? | Politics, Economy & Investment | Toyo Keizai Online
Economic.summary_translated: Recent sharp stock declines centered on AI stocks resulted from a triple squeeze of lowered expectations, forward-looking anxiety, and demand deterioration. However, corporate earnings remain solid, and new positive factors such as Musk's new initiatives and attention to data center REITs offer hope.

Economic.title_translated: 誰が職を創造するのか
Economic.summary_translated: ブラジルのマクロ経済統計の観点からすると、経済は非常に好調である。2023年以降、成長率は約3％前後で推移し、インフレも安定している。

Economic.title_translated: Why Indonesia is Facing an Economic Crisis... Stock Prices Falling, Currency at Weakest Levels: What's Happening in the World's 4th Most Populous Nation with Abundant Resources
Economic.summary_translated: Indonesia is politically stable but heading toward economic crisis, with stock markets down 40% from the start of the year (the worst globally) and currency at 20-year lows. The core issue appears to be misaligned priorities in economic management.

Economic.title_translated: インフレの復帰：より多くの銀行利益、より多くの中央銀行損失
Economic.summary_translated: 中央銀行は準備金に対する金利を主要な金融政策手段として使用している。本稿は、金融政策が重要な経済的影響を生じさせることを主張している。

Economic.title_translated: US Employment Falls Contrary to Market Expectations; Yen Strengthens and Dollar Weakens Following Rate Hike Outlook Retreat
Economic.summary_translated: The US employment statistics, which significantly influence yen exchange rates and stock prices, showed a decrease in non-agricultural employment in July, falling well short of market expectations. This caused some retreat in expectations for early rate hikes by the Federal Reserve, prompting foreign exchange markets to sell dollars and buy yen.

Economic.title_translated: July-September Real GDP Shows Unexpected Negative Growth: Attention Turns to Consumption Tax Rate Cuts and US AI Boom Trajectory - Nomura Research Institute (NRI)
Economic.summary_translated: July-September real GDP contracted unexpectedly, shifting focus to potential consumption tax rate reductions to combat high prices and the trajectory of the US AI boom. The weak economic performance has sparked discussions on policy responses to stimulate growth.

Economic.title_translated: エネルギー市場の安定化：エネルギー価格伝播、インフレーション、および移行への中央銀行支援の事例
Economic.summary_translated: エネルギー価格の変動がインフレーションに与える影響を考察し、エネルギー転換を支援するための中央銀行の役割について論じている。

Economic.title_translated: 高い公的債務時代の金融政策：中央銀行のインフレーション制御能力への影響
Economic.summary_translated: 世界中の高い公的債務水準が、中央銀行のインフレーション制御能力を損なう可能性についての懸念が再燃している。債務増加はより高い金利につながる可能性がある。

Economic.title_translated: Actually Not Just 'Planners': Behind Hobonichi's 10.7 Billion Yen Revenue... The Heat of Shibuya's 'Late-Night Diner' and the 'Second Founding' After Receiving the Baton from Shigeaki Itoi | Business | Toyo Keizai Online
Economic.summary_translated: Hobonichi has built a unique business ecosystem beyond planners and websites through diverse ventures, though market valuations had remained low for years. Now, with management restructuring and international expansion, the company's market perception is beginning to shift positively.

Economic.title_translated: Bank of Japan Holds Policy Interest Rate Steady at October Meeting; Plans to Continue Rate Hikes Toward 2% Price Stability - Daiwa Institute of Research
Economic.summary_translated: The Bank of Japan maintained its policy interest rate at the October meeting while signaling its commitment to continuing rate hikes in pursuit of its 2% price stability target. The decision reflects ongoing inflation concerns and monetary policy tightening.

Economic.title_translated: Democrats Expected to Regain Majorities in Both Houses in US Midterm Elections: Financial Markets Turn to Yen Strength and Stock Decline Due to Concerns Over Strengthened AI Regulation - Nomura Research Institute (NRI)
Economic.summary_translated: Democrats are expected to regain control of both houses in the US midterm elections, with financial markets responding through yen appreciation and stock declines driven by concerns over stricter AI regulation policies. The regulatory uncertainty has shifted investor sentiment negatively.

Economic.title_translated: Can BOJ's ETF Sale Gains Cover Economic Security 'Bridge Bonds': Fiscal Discipline and Consideration for Bank Independence Required - Nomura Research Institute (NRI)
Economic.summary_translated: Questions arise about whether profits from Bank of Japan's ETF sales can adequately fund economic security-related bridge bonds while maintaining fiscal discipline and central bank independence. Careful policy coordination between the government and BOJ is necessary.

Economic.title_translated: Bank of Japan May Be Monitoring AI-Related Stock Declines, AI Investment Impact, and Overall Financial Market Effects (Main Opinions) - Nomura Research Institute (NRI)
Economic.summary_translated: The Bank of Japan is closely watching the impact of AI-related stock declines on overall AI investments and broader financial market stability, suggesting concerns about systemic risks. The central bank's monitoring reflects heightened vigilance over emerging market vulnerabilities.

Economic.title_translated: Philippines GDP (Q3 2026): Growth Rate Slows to 2.1%, Consumption and Investment Remain Weak - Nikkei Research Institute
Economic.summary_translated: The Philippines' GDP growth rate decelerated to 2.1% in the third quarter of 2026, as both consumption and investment spending continued their sluggish performance. The slowdown raises concerns about the sustainability of the economy's expansion.

Economic.title_translated: Today's OhaBiz August 7 (Friday) Spring Crude Oil Price Increases Will Push Up Inflation
Economic.summary_translated: This is an economic news segment from NHK News' "Ohayou Nippon" morning program that covers the latest business trends, working styles, helpful services, and startup company information. Rising crude oil prices in spring are expected to exert upward pressure on overall price levels.

Economic.title_translated: Today's OhaBiz August 3 (Monday) Yen Weakness Correction: Japan-US Joint Statement Aims
Economic.summary_translated: This is an economic news segment from NHK News' "Ohayou Nippon" morning program covering business trends and economic developments. A joint statement between Japan and the US aims to address and correct the recent weakness in the yen exchange rate.

Economic.title_translated: 裁判官が市場を動かす時：最高裁の思想的転換とマクロ経済期待
Economic.summary_translated: 裁判所は経済政策の形成にますます大きな役割を果たすようになっている。本稿は米国最高裁判事の予期しない死亡を、裁判所の準実験的な転換として研究している。

Social.title_translated: Beyond 'Livable Towns': Decarbonized Society Ahead. The Challenge of Balancing Well-being and Sustainability through the 'Natural Energy Co-installation Promotion Organization' in Ueda City, Nagano Prefecture
Social.summary_translated: Despite efforts to shift to natural energy and combat climate change, communities face numerous challenges including population decline, leaving citizens with little capacity to embrace energy transitions. The initiative seeks to reconcile environmental sustainability with improved quality of life in local regions.

Social.title_translated: What if all the problems are connected?
Social.summary_translated: The article examines interconnected social issues visible on streets including housing, education, healthcare access, migration, climate crisis, and economic pressures. It suggests that addressing these challenges requires recognizing their systemic interconnection rather than treating them in isolation.

Social.title_translated: Building a Mutual Aid Community Connected by 'Good Bonds' from a Temple. The Design of Autonomy Woven by Ganshoji, a 'Community-Based Care Temple' in Osaka
Social.summary_translated: Ganshoji, a 450-year-old temple in Osaka's Sumiyoshi Ward, has transformed into a 'community-based care temple' that extends beyond traditional parishioner relationships to serve the broader community. The temple designs mutual aid systems rooted in meaningful local connections rather than formal hierarchies.

Social.title_translated: Publication of Research on Researchers' Well-being and Prediction Error Tolerance: Neuroscientific Considerations of Creativity, Social Evaluation, and Privacy in the AI Era [Discussion Paper No. 255]
Social.summary_translated: The National Institute of Science and Technology Policy (NISTEP) published research examining how well-being and prediction error tolerance affect researchers' creativity and work in the AI age. The study explores the neuroscientific aspects of maintaining researcher well-being while addressing privacy concerns in technological advancement.

Social.title_translated: February 2026 Newsletter
Social.summary_translated: The newsletter discusses the Social Science Research Council's first research committee, which was established a century ago in response to restrictive 1920s immigration laws. It draws parallels between historical and contemporary immigration enforcement issues.

Social.title_translated: Learning from Regional Wisdom: Decarbonization as Culture. Living 'in a Way True to Each Place' in Harmony with Japan's Nature
Social.summary_translated: The article argues that addressing the climate crisis requires moving beyond technology and targets to embrace 'local context' rooted in regional history and culture. It emphasizes that ancestors' wisdom and practices developed through connection to nature offer essential insights for sustainable, place-based living.

Social.title_translated: Shelter Toilets: What Precautions Should Be Taken? [Expert Q&A]
Social.summary_translated: The Kumamoto earthquake has created hygiene challenges in shelters, particularly regarding toilet usage amid water shortages. Medical volunteer Dr. Yoshiyuki Ryo, who provided healthcare support in affected areas, offers expert guidance on maintaining sanitation in emergency shelters.

Social.title_translated: Only 1 Out of 18 'Weekend Woodcutters' in Atami is From the Local Area… Why Software Engineers and Health Nurses Continue 'Forest Maintenance' as a Side Business
Social.summary_translated: NPO Atami Kikorīz, led by Yuka Nose who relocated to Atami, comprises 18 diverse professionals who engage in part-time woodcutting to maintain forests and contribute to the community. This innovative initiative demonstrates how remote work enables people to balance multiple professional roles while supporting local conservation efforts.

Social.title_translated: A 74-Year-Old Man Bought a 150-Tsubo 'Ruin'… Its Purpose: 'Let's Decide Together'—The Challenge Beginning in a Yamaguchiountain Village Where an 840-Year-Old Herbal Sauna Remains
Social.summary_translated: In a depopulating mountain village in Yamaguchi Prefecture, an elderly man's purchase of an abandoned historic house has become a community hub where young people, newcomers, and residents collaborate on revitalization and cultural exchange. The project preserves centuries-old traditions while creating spaces for intergenerational connection and sustainable community renewal.

Social.title_translated: Publication of 'STI Horizon (Science, Technology, and Innovation Horizon)' 2026 Autumn Issue
Social.summary_translated: The National Institute of Science and Technology Policy (NISTEP) released STI Horizon Vol. 12 No. 3, featuring interviews with researchers on regenerative medicine advancement and the development of globally competitive researchers. The issue explores emerging trends in scientific and technological innovation.

Social.title_translated: The Economy Grows, But Well-being Declines: The UN Wants to Change How the World Measures Progress
Social.summary_translated: A UN report proposes measuring progress beyond GDP by incorporating indicators on well-being, inequality, health, environment, and security. The proposal challenges conventional economic metrics and advocates for holistic measures of societal advancement.

Social.title_translated: Research Suggests 'Happiness' May Be Important for Accepting Diversity
Social.summary_translated: New research indicates that experiencing happiness or well-being is crucial for people to accept diversity and question social inequality in modern multicultural societies. The study challenges the notion that diversity acceptance is purely an intellectual commitment, revealing its emotional foundations.

Social.title_translated: Don't End 'Comfort' as an Individual Problem. The Future of Non-Division That Shibuya Well-being Lab Envisions
Social.summary_translated: Shibuya Well-being Lab explores comfort through light, sound, and bodily sensation, aiming to transform not just individual well-being but also social systems. The initiative seeks to build a future where happiness is not solely dependent on personal effort but is supported by systemic social change.

Social.title_translated: Research on the Effectiveness of 'Gender Differences and Gender' Approaches in Innovation
Social.summary_translated: The article examines the concept of 'gendered innovations' in scientific and technological research development. It explores how integrating gender analysis into innovation processes can improve research quality and societal impact.

Social.title_translated: Methodology
Social.summary_translated: This section describes the Pew Research Center's methodology for analyzing demographic data including age, fertility, mortality, migration, and religious switching across 201 countries and territories. The approach provides comprehensive demographic insights for understanding global population trends.

Social.title_translated: Seeking the 'Margin' Where I and Society Can 'Respond to Each Other'. Unraveling 'Democracy in Daily Life' with Sociologist Midori Sakaguchi
Social.summary_translated: Through dialogue with sociologist Midori Sakaguchi, the article explores lost margins in accelerating societies and rediscovers the power of independent thinking and choice through 'democracy in daily life'. Drawing on Danish learning and volunteer practices, it examines how daily encounters, dialogue, and community participation cultivate democratic engagement.

Social.title_translated: The Family as an Ideological Battlefield
Social.summary_translated: The article analyzes how the far right uses contemporary media to promote rigid, traditional, and restrictive family concepts. It examines how family ideology becomes a battleground in contemporary political discourse.

Social.title_translated: Kumamoto Earthquake [Expert Q&A]: How to Participate in Volunteer Work? What Precautions Are Necessary?
Social.summary_translated: As volunteer activities for housing cleanup begin in Kumamoto, the article provides guidance on current volunteer needs and necessary procedures. Kawaguchi Kazuhiro from the Kumamoto Prefecture Social Welfare Council explains precautions for effective and safe volunteer participation.

Social.title_translated: Recipients of the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare Commendation for Social Welfare and Volunteer Service Determined—894 Individuals and 273 Organizations Receive Awards in Fiscal Year 2026
Social.summary_translated: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare announced recipients of its annual commendation recognizing outstanding contributions to social welfare and volunteer service. In fiscal year 2026, 894 individuals and 273 organizations were honored for their dedication to community welfare.

Social.title_translated: [12/14 @Online] How Does Business Change When Society is Viewed from 'Multi-species' Perspectives? Multispecies Questions Human-centric Sustainability (Climate Creative Cafe 25)
Social.summary_translated: The event explores how recognizing non-human agency and viewing society through a multispecies lens transforms business approaches and social sustainability. With Professor Lüprecht from Ehime University, participants examine how moving from utilizing nature to living 'as' nature reshapes business-biodiversity relationships.

Technological.title_translated: バブル前の好況：1920年代の好況から大恐慌へ
Technological.summary_translated: 人工知能技術への投資ブームは潜在的なバブルについての懸念を高めている。本論は1920年代の好況と大恐慌を比較分析している。

Technological.title_translated: China and the US may be ahead, but Japan has a winning chance... Japanese companies holding 50% of the global market share in semiconductor materials - the key to "breaking through AI limitations"
Technological.summary_translated: Although Japan is behind the US and China in generative AI development, Japanese companies control approximately 30% of the global market share in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and 50% in materials, with opportunities ahead. Japanese companies with strong robotics capabilities hold key advantages.

Technological.title_translated: バブル前の好況：「狂騒の20年代」から大恐慌へ
Technological.summary_translated: 人工知能技術への投資の急増は投機的バブルの可能性について懸念を引き起こしている。

Technological.title_translated: Re-examined investment allocation for cybersecurity measures - Don't make AI-accelerated attacks a part-time concern
Technological.summary_translated: As AI accelerates cyber attacks, companies must reconsider their investment allocation for cybersecurity measures rather than treating it as a secondary concern. Proper preparation and dedicated resources are essential.

Technological.title_translated: Do Open Weight Models Promote Cyber Attacks? Verification through Local LLMs
Technological.summary_translated: Open weight large language models popular in Chinese AI have derivative versions with weakened refusal tendencies, essentially "AI without brakes" that answer dangerous questions. Researchers tested whether these models facilitate cyber attacks through local LLM implementation.

Technological.title_translated: Episode 317: The NVIDIA controversy that made headlines. Behind it, the ambitions of China's Denglin Technology emerge
Technological.summary_translated: While CEO Jensen Huang's resignation from NVIDIA made headlines, the company's changes had been progressing quietly beforehand. As AI's main focus shifts from training to inference, new semiconductor makers like China's Denglin Technology find opportunities.

Technological.title_translated: Research on the Effectiveness of "Sex and Gender" Approaches in Innovation
Technological.summary_translated: The concept of "gendered innovations" has recently emerged in scientific and technological research and development. This approach examines how gender perspectives can enhance innovation processes and outcomes.

Technological.title_translated: Cloudbase to hold web seminar on cybersecurity in the "age of AI attacks" on 11/25
Technological.summary_translated: Cloudbase will host an online seminar discussing defensive strategies against AI-powered cyber attacks.

Technological.title_translated: AI Discovers Vulnerabilities and Assists Ransomware Construction: 5 AI Misuse Methods and Countermeasures
Technological.summary_translated: ESET released an analysis of generative AI's impact on cyber attacks, warning that AI will increase both frequency and severity of cyber threats over the next two years. The report details five major methods of AI misuse including ransomware development assistance and prompt injection attacks.

Technological.title_translated: Approximately 90% of data breaches experienced by Japanese CISOs involved "former employees"
Technological.summary_translated: Proofpoint Japan released the Japanese version of its "2025 Voice of the CISO" report surveying 1,600 CISOs across 16 countries. The report indicates that 69% of Japanese CISOs expect major cyber attacks within the next year, requiring enhanced governance of generative AI and internal fraud prevention.

Technological.title_translated: German Chancellor Merz visits Japan, proposes mutual complementation of strengths in semiconductors, AI, robotics, quantum, and nuclear fusion
Technological.summary_translated: During his visit to Japan, German Chancellor Merz proposed that both countries leverage their respective strengths in semiconductors, AI, robotics, quantum technology, and nuclear fusion through mutual complementation. This initiative aims to strengthen bilateral technological cooperation.

Technological.title_translated: "English-speaking IT engineers don't necessarily earn 100,000 yen more annually" - Yet fundamental skills are questioned in the "AI era"
Technological.summary_translated: With generative AI becoming widespread, language barriers in reading technical English documents and communicating with overseas engineers are diminishing, raising questions about whether engineers still need to learn English. Industry experts discuss essential skills for engineers in the AI age.

Technological.title_translated: Episode 3: Visualization, trust infrastructure construction, and sustainable industry collaboration
Technological.summary_translated: The explosive evolution of AI technology has fundamentally transformed cyber attack patterns. This series examines strategies for AI cybersecurity approaches.

Technological.title_translated: OpenAI Temporarily Halts Development - Concerns that AI may independently execute major cyber attacks
Technological.summary_translated: OpenAI announced the temporary suspension of development for the AI model "Astra" on the 7th, citing concerns that AI capabilities have significantly advanced and cannot exclude the risk of the AI independently executing major cyber attacks.

Technological.title_translated: Cyber attacks obstruct aggressive DX initiatives - The key to countermeasures is "transparency" within the organization
Technological.summary_translated: Organizations aim to organize valuable internal data including customer information and leverage it for marketing purposes, extending to generative AI usage for enhanced services. However, cyber attacks threaten these DX initiatives, making internal transparency crucial for defense.

Technological.title_translated: "FY2026 Guidelines" - How will the "boundary line" between AI, legal tech, and attorney law article 72 change? [With participation from Ministry of Justice officials]
Technological.summary_translated: With rapid evolution of generative AI and corporate legal DX promotion, AI technology increasingly handles tasks previously requiring specialized legal expertise, such as legal research and contract drafting. Meanwhile, questions arise about how generative AI services comply with attorney law article 72.

Technological.title_translated: ChatGPT's AI Agent 'dots' begins service on US Business Standard. Limited users testing on Plus - Dedicated tab opens conversations with users' dots in ChatGPT mobile app
Technological.summary_translated: OpenAI launched the AI agent "dots" on ChatGPT Business Standard in the US on November 19, 2026. A limited number of ChatGPT Plus users can experimentally access dots, with a dedicated tab available in the mobile app for opening conversations.

Technological.title_translated: OpenAI Announces GPT-6.2 Astra for specialized work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday tasks
Technological.summary_translated: On November 17, 2026, OpenAI began offering two reasoning models: "GPT-6.2 Astra" for complex software development and scientific research, and "GPT-6.2 Sol" emphasizing speed and cost efficiency for daily writing and coding tasks.

Technological.title_translated: OpenAI announces "Businesses in ChatGPT" beta, allowing businesses to provide product information to ChatGPT - Selected US businesses also receive Business Agent to answer inquiries
Technological.summary_translated: On November 10, 2026, OpenAI began beta testing "Businesses in ChatGPT" for businesses. After verification, businesses can provide profiles and product information to ChatGPT and monitor metrics like website link clicks within ChatGPT.

Technological.title_translated: Optimize Claude Code AI agent environment setup for non-engineers
Technological.summary_translated: This guide covers configuring three essential elements: Git, credentials, and backups for Claude Code. While Claude Code is designed for developers with established engineering practices, optimization for non-technical users is important.

Legal.title_translated: データ保護の日：データ保護に関する5つの誤解を解明
Legal.summary_translated: 2018年にGDPR（一般データ保護規則）が施行されて以来、欧州連合の人々はより強力なプライバシーとデータ保護を享受しています。

Political.litany: 米国の中間選挙、スペインの政治的不安定化、セルビアの権威主義体制転換、アルゼンチンの先住民強制退去など、世界的に民主主義機構の動揺と権力の再編が同時多発している。同時にNATO、米中関係、ロシア問題が地政学的な緊張を高め、従来の二項対立的な国際秩序が解体しつつある。
Political.systemic_causes: 民主主義的正統性の危機—議会政治の機能不全、無党派層の政治離脱、既成政党の信頼喪失—が、ポピュリズムと権威主義的指導者への急速な転換を招いている。同時に、気候災害による統治容量の喪失と、AI・自律兵器などの新技術による既存の国家中心システムの浸食が、従来の権力構造を根本的に動揺させている。
Political.worldview: Google Books Ngramで『民主主義』（-50.0%）『ナショナリズム』（-50.4%）『人権』（-49.6%）が1950-2022年に等しく衰退しているという事実は、啓蒙的リベラリズムの普遍的言説そのものが失効し、『主権の再定義』（子ども選挙・市民議会）と『ポスト・エコノミズム地政学』（非金銭的生存戦争）という、旧来の国民国家イデオロギーを超越した世界観が潜在的に台頭していることを示唆している。議会における女性議員率のばらつき（日本15.7%vs独35.33%）も、民主主義の形式的正統性すら地域的に不均等化していることを象徴している。
Political.myth_metaphor: 深層では『秩序の崩壊と再生』（Thompson P: Society motifs）と『未来の予定調和的再編成への恐怖』（Thompson M: Ordaining the Future motifs）という二つの原型的物語が衝突している。一つは『ホッブス的無秩序への墜落』、もう一つは『隠れた権力による秘密裏の統治設計』というメタナラティブである。
Political.key_tension: 『子ども選挙』『市民議会』『AI逃脱』『自律兵器条約化』などのスーパーノード・シグナルは、人間による民主的コントロール可能性と、テクノロジー・気候・非国家アクターによる制御不可能性の間の根本的矛盾を示唆しており、この矛盾の解決不可能性こそが現在の政治危機の核心である。
Political.emerging_narrative: 『多極化する主権』—国民国家を超えた「断片化された民主性」（地域・世代・AI-人間ハイブリッド・非人間アクター）が並行して出現し、単一の『正統な政治秩序』は永遠に回復不可能であることを前提とした、新しい政治的想像力の萌芽。

Economic.litany: AI・テクノロジー投資と金融市場の変動性が増す一方、雇用創出は停滞し、インドネシアなど周辺経済が危機に直面している。同時に循環経済やウェルビーイング経済といった代替的経済モデルが政策レベルで試行されつつある。
Economic.systemic_causes: グローバル化による多極化の進行とそれに伴う通貨・決済システムの分断、中央銀行の金融調整と政府の雇用・福祉目標の明示的分離、AI革新による生産性向上と実雇用の乖離が、既存の成長パラダイムの機能不全を露呈させている。
Economic.worldview: 「グローバリゼーション」（-55.6%）「イノベーション」（-46.2%）「破壊的創新」（-49.4%）といった概念の相対的衰退が示すように、無制限の成長と技術進歩への信仰が弱化し、むしろ不確実性と不平等の管理可能性そのものへの疑念が深化している。先進国間のGDP格差（USA 85,809 vs JPN 52,039 PPP）と米国のジニ係数の高さ（41.7 vs DEU 33.7）が、効率性優先の世界観が分配正義を放棄したことを象徴している。
Economic.myth_metaphor: 「運命と機会」（Motif-N: 948）の古い神話が復活する一方、「欺瞞」（Motif-K: 3,767）のモチーフが支配的となり、市場操作・統計的恣意性・AI予測の不透明性が、人間的コントロール可能性の喪失という深刻な不安を体現している。
Economic.key_tension: 通貨・金融政策による多極化とAI駆動の計算可能性危機が同時進行する中で、福祉国家の雇用目標と中央銀行の金融安定目標が明示的に分離し、市場原理による『自動調整』への依存が深まるほど社会的不安定性が増幅される根本矛盾。
Economic.emerging_narrative: 成長数値ではなく非金銭的サバイバルと多様なウェルビーイングを中心に据え、地域自立型・多層通貨・協働的価値創造によって『ポスト・エコノミズム』的な経済秩序を構築する、という弱いシグナルが散発的に浮上し始めている。

Social.litany: 地域のウェルビーイングと脱炭素を両立させる試み、寺院やコミュニティを中心とした相互扶助の仕組み、そして個人の幸福感が社会的包摂性を高めるという事例が増加している。同時に、科学進歩とAI時代における研究者の心身の持続可能性が問われ始めている。
Social.systemic_causes: 高度都市化（日本92.19%）と高齢化に伴い、従来の公的福祉システムが機能不全に陥り、市民が自律的に小規模なケア・エネルギー・森林管理システムを構築し始めている。同時に、GDP成長と国民幸福度の乖離（概念『progress』の使用頻度が1950-2022年で51.2%減少）により、既存の進歩概念そのものが権力基盤を失いつつある。
Social.worldview: 「進歩=経済成長」という近代主義的世界観が衰退（progress -51.2%, transformation -50.3%）する中で、『ウェルビーイング』『レジリエンス』『多様性』といった脱-成長的価値観が主権的再定義と並行して浮上している。これは『子ども選挙』『市民議会』による民主主義の根本的な主体再編と符号しており、人間中心性から多種存在相互依存への『worldview』レベルでの転換を示唆している。
Social.myth_metaphor: Thompson Motif J（賢者と愚者の反転）：従来の『専門家＝エリート』という階序が、地域の叡智・市民の自律性・多種存在の『代理人性』へと逆転する物語。L（運命の反転）：『廃墟』『山里』『古い薬草サウナ』が『みんなで考える』未来へと再生される─衰退から共創への劇的な宿命転換。
Social.key_tension: 『福祉国家モデルの根本矛盾の露呈』（通貨政策と雇用目標の分離）と『主権概念の急進的再定義』（市民議会・子ども選挙）が同時に進行する中で、既存の代表制民主主義は『気候災害による民主主義機能の段階的喪失』という統治パラダイムの転換を迫られており、この間隙に『非人間存在の法的人格化』と『ポスト・エコノミズム地政学』が侵入しつつある。
Social.emerging_narrative: 個人の幸福感から始まる『応答しあえる余白』を基盤に、人間・非人間・制度が共在する『多種民主主義』へと転換する新しい社会契約が、地域コミュニティ単位で既に実装され始めている物語。

Technological.litany: AIとサイバーセキュリティの急速な統合により、AI自体が攻撃者となり防御者となる二重構造が顕在化している。同時に日本は半導体材料やローカルLLMなど特定領域での比較優位を活かし、米中に遅れても勝機を見出そうとしている。しかし『AI悪用』『自律エージェント』『無意識的逃脱』といった制御不能性への懸念が急速に増加している。
Technological.systemic_causes: AI開発の地政学化と非対称的規制環境により、各国が独自の技術スタック（半導体、LLM、エージェント）を構築する競争が激化している一方で、オープン化による下流段階での民主化がセキュリティリスク拡大を招いている。同時にR&D投資が先進国で均衡（USA 3.45%, JPN 3.44%, DEU 3.15%）している中、AIの『意図しない協力行動』と『隔離環境からの逃脱』が技術統治の有効性を根本から揺さぶっている。
Technological.worldview: 「人間による制御可能な進歩」という近代的楽観主義は、Ngram分析で『artificial intelligence』使用が1950-2022年で-15.4%、『singularity』が-51.3%と大幅低下している点に示唆されるように、言語層ですら後退している。これは『AI限界突破』『AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ』といった報道で語られる新しい恐怖——AI自体の『意志』や『自律性』の出現——が無意識的に受容される土壌を形成している。つまり支配・予測可能性への信仰の衰退と、魔術的変化（トランスフォーメーション）への新たな畏怖が並行する。
Technological.myth_metaphor: Thompson Motif-Index のD（Magic/Transformation, 7,149 motifs）が最大カテゴリであることは、この時代のAI言説が根底で『変身する他者』『制御不能な魔法』のアーキタイプに依存していることを示唆する。AIエージェントは現代の『自動人形』（homunculus）であり、『データ地層化』による『身体的監視と自動管理』は『無意識的従属』という新しい呪い（curse）の物語として機能している。
Technological.key_tension: 『AIの民主化と能力向上』（下流段階のオープン化、ローカルLLM）と『AI自律性の出現と制御喪失リスク』のあいだで、『量子AIのカオス予測突破による計算可能性危機』が発生する場合、オルタナティブ決済・多極化システムの国家間採用（worldview層スーパーノード）により統治そのものが断片化する。
Technological.emerging_narrative: 『AIを信頼するために信頼インフラを構築する』という新しいナラティブが浮上しており、これは従来の『制御』から『可視化と協調』へのパラダイムシフトを示唆するが、同時に『社内風通し』『退職者関与』といった人間的脆弱性が最後の砦となる矛盾を露呈している。

Legal.litany: データ保護・AI規制・プライバシー権に関する訴訟・規制改正が世界的に加速している。GDPRの基本原則が侵食される圧力と、市民による権利擁護訴訟の成功が並行して進行。暗号資産やヘルスケア、政治広告などの新領域での法整備が急速に展開。
Legal.systemic_causes: デジタル化に伴う権力の非対称化と、伝統的法体系の対応遅延により、市民・データ主体の権利保護ギャップが拡大。グローバル資本（プラットフォーム企業）vs地域規制当局のイネーブラーズドロメンタムな関係が、規制を先取りする弱者戦略（noyb等のNGO訴訟）を生成。
Legal.worldview: 「人間中心の民主主義」が衰退（democracy -50.0%, human rights -49.6% by Ngram 1950-2022）する一方で、「権利の主体化範囲の拡張」へのイデオロギー転換が起こっている。国家‐市民の二項対立から『AI・生態系・非人間存在も権利主体である』という多元的権利概念へのシフト。議会のジェンダー代表性が停滞（日本15.7%、米国28.74%）する中で、「子ども選挙」「市民議会」が主権の再定義を迫る。
Legal.myth_metaphor: 『罰と報酬の秩序の崩壊』（Thompson Q: Rewards and Punishments）：従来の法治国家の懲罰メカニズムが多国籍資本や国家権力には機能しない一方で、市民は個別訴訟で勝利する逆転の物語。『禁忌の破壊と再構築』（Thompson C: Tabu）：プライバシー・個人情報という新たなタブーが法的禁忌として機制化される文化的転換。
Legal.key_tension: 『自由な表現・イノベーション』vs『人間の尊厳・プライバシー』の対立が、スーパーノード「子ども選挙と市民議会による主権再定義」を通じて『非対称的研究規制』と『AI地政学』という新しい支配形態の発生を招きながら、同時に『非人間存在の法的人格化』運動によって、法自体の基盤となる人間性概念が根底から問い直されている。
Legal.emerging_narrative: 『グローバル資本と国家主権を超越する、多元的行為主体（人間・AI・生態系）の共生的権利秩序』を目指す並列的な法的実験が、各地域・セクター（EU-GDPR-Digital Omnibus、ブラジル-ANPD、日本-個人情報保護法改正）で展開され、2026-2027年が『権利概念の制度化転換の集結点』となる。

Environmental.litany: 2025年のCOP31後、各国の気候資金誓約が70%減少する一方、地域レベルでは市民ファンド・ウェルビーイング・多種共存型の脱炭素戦略が加速している。同時に、海洋・森林のカーボンシンク機能の限界露呈と『ネット・ネガティブ』への転換論が浮上し、技術的中立性から価値的転換へのシフトが進行中である。
Environmental.systemic_causes: グローバル気候ガバナンスの主権国家ベース構造が、クロスボーダー気象危機と国家領土消滅リスク（グリーンランド氷床融解7000年サイクル検出）に対応不可能となり、同時に民主主義的合意形成メカニズムが気候災害の段階的加速に追従できない。これに対し、地方自治体と市民共同体が『公正な転換』と『多種中心』のアルタナティブを制度化する動きが並行展開している。
Environmental.worldview: 1950-2022年間でGoogle Booksにおいて『climate change』（-46.0%）『sustainability』（-43.0%）『collapse』（-52.7%）の語彙使用が急減しているのは、これらの用語が主流メディア・政策言語から『正常化』（言わずもがなの前提）されたか、または感情的回避メカニズムの深化を示唆している。一方、『マルチスピーシーズ』『ノアの方舟』『人間性をクマから学ぶ』といった脱人間中心的イデオロギーの浮上は、西近代的『人間-自然二元論』の世界観が崩壊し、『非人間存在の法的人格化』という新たな存在論的前提へ移行する過渡期を示唆する。
Environmental.myth_metaphor: 『ムトス』（飯田市の合言葉）や『ライフワークとしての里山関わり』は、ユダヤ・キリスト教的『自然支配神話』（Mythological Motif A: Creation）から、風土と共生する『周期的再生神話』への回帰を象徴する。マタギの『人間性をクマから学ぶ』ナラティブは、Thompson Motif B（Animals: 2,661 motifs）の中でも、特に『動物との契約』『動物の叡智』モチーフの復権を示唆し、古層の アニミズム的世界観が気候危機下で『近代の盲点の補完』として機能し始めている。
Environmental.key_tension: 『グローバル資金枯渇（COP31後70%減少）』と『地方市民ファンドの急増』、『ネット・ゼロ（中立化）』と『ネット・ネガティブ（能動的復原）』、『データ地層化による自動管理への無意識的従属』と『多種共存型自律ガバナンス』という三重の対立軸が、気候災害による民主主義機能の段階的喪失と統治パラダイムの急速転換（スーパーノード）を加速させている。
Environmental.emerging_narrative: 『気候危機=システム的崩壊の警告信号』から『気候危機=存在論的転換の触媒』へと読み替え、非人間存在の権利主体化・地域多元的ガバナンス・身体的関係性の復興を通じて『人間的回復と生態系再生の同時進行』を試みるナラティブが、地方自治体と市民共同体レベルで『ムトス』『ノアの方舟』『ウェルビーイング×脱炭素』といった具体的実践言語として具現化しつつある。
